subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

BLCM : FHGI :: KHWS : ?
solution:
Table show alphabet serial number –

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55076ea54395deab263d9b051c59629eca76721df23f2e015a81f3f08dd2601e.png] 

The pattern for the code is as follows,

BLCM : FHGI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33df77ced6b4bac55df3d0a0aedbbba439a2201b3ed126951b8e215db6213f79.png] 

Similarly,

KHWS : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/448ff70fd043c2d35ae38ad3ff82f2bd76bc6e6509aca94c088304ff46d5ad95.png] 

Hence, KHWS is coded as **“ODAO”**.
